description: Defines the NetworkChangeNotifierMac class for monitoring network changes on macOS, including a nested Forwarder class for handling network configuration callbacks.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierMac
classes.description: Monitors network changes on macOS, providing current connection type and handling network configuration updates.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierMac::Forwarder
classes.description: Handles callbacks from NetworkConfigWatcherMac to update network change notifications.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: SetDynamicStoreNotificationKeys
methods.description: Sets notification keys for dynamic store updates.

methods.name: CalculateConnectionType
methods.description: Calculates connection type based on network flags.

methods.name: SetInitialConnectionType
methods.description: Sets the initial network connection type.

methods.name: ReachabilityCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked on reachability status change.

methods.name: NetworkChangeCalculatorParamsMac
methods.description: Returns network change calculator parameters for macOS.
